Data.//: Everything RaceTrade reads and writes lives under this one folder: sites, cbftp, pre_bots, sections, settings, db, userdata, logs. Relative to the executable, or use an absolute path (e.g. C:\RaceTradeData) to keep your data outside the install folder so updating the binary never touches it. Override at runtime with: RaceTrade --data <path>

Web.//: Loopback only by default. Change BindAddress to 0.0.0.0 to reach it from other machines - a password is then REQUIRED and the app refuses to start without one. Prefer a WireGuard/Tailscale/SSH tunnel over exposing this port: it stores site and cbftp credentials.
